messages:
mia-ramirez: FYI Northstar sent an RFI plus a request to run a 2-week POC. Requirements: EU data residency, HSM/KMS integration, dedicated GPU pool, and a simple perf target (p95 < 120ms for 16k context). They also want a pricing comparison for reserved vs burst and a capability matrix. Need a coordinated response by EOD tomorrow.
liam-m: Got it. Who owns the HSM/KMS write-up? We should confirm if our Private offering + customer-managed KMS covers their ask.
andrew-eng: I can draft the KMS/HSM section. Quick question: do they require a specific HSM vendor (Luna/CloudHSM) or just HSM-backed key management?
terra-cs: Northstar mentioned AWS CloudHSM in their note but said vendor flexibility is ok as long as FIPS 140-2 Level 3 equivalence is met.
mia-ramirez: Perfect — include CloudHSM example and note that we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM in Private. Also add documented export controls and data segregation language.
jason-pm: I'll own the capability matrix and POC runbook. Can someone paste our standard matrix snippet? I'll tailor it for EU residency and HSM rows.
andrew-eng: Pasting a compact matrix to copy into the RFI (trimmed for Slack):
```
Feature | Hosted API | Dedicated | Private (VPC)
---------|------------|-----------|----------------
EU data residency | EU region only* | Customer region pin | Full customer-controlled
Customer-managed KMS/HSM | No | Partial (BYOK in some configs) | Yes (CloudHSM / HSM appliances)
Dedicated GPU pools | No | Yes (reserved) | Yes (on-prem option)
Latency SLO | best-effort | SLA-backed p95 target | Configurable per deployment
Operational access | Redwood-managed | Redwood-managed (isolated) | Customer-managed controls
```
mia-ramirez: Add a note to the matrix: "*Hosted EU region has shared hardware; for strict tenancy use Dedicated or Private."
liam-m: For pricing, do we have a short table: Reserved monthly commit vs hourly burst? If so send numbers I can anonymize for the RFI (they asked for ranges).
jason-pm: Use the standard bands: Reserved: $Xk/month per GPU equivalent (committed), Burst: $Y/hour (on-demand). I will flag that final pricing requires a usage profile and infra negotiations.
andrew-eng: For the POC ops we need to confirm: 1) Dedicated pool allocation window 2) Access to sample dataset 3) Contact for on-call infra during run. Drafting runbook now.
terra-cs: I'll request the dataset and legal NDA addendum from the customer and confirm timeline. Also I'll call out acceptance criteria: throughput benchmarks + qualitative evaluation on hallucination rates on a fixed prompt set.
security-bot: Security checklist note: SOC2 Type II (available), ISO 27001 (in progress), Pen test summary (latest: Jan 2025), Support for customer-managed HSM (CloudHSM) and audit log exports.
mia-ramirez: Great. Who can assemble attachments? Need: capability_matrix.csv, poc_runbook.md, kms_hsm_faq.pdf, and redwood-soc2-summary.pdf uploaded to the RFI reply.
liam-m: I can compile capability_matrix.csv from Jason's matrix. Will drop a link when ready.
jason-pm: Runbook draft ETA 4pm PT. Will include a short test harness script snippet and the perf measurement commands.
andrew-eng: Example perf command I'll include in runbook:
```bash
./benchmark_client --model redwood-v2 --context 16384 --concurrency 8 --target-pct 95
```
terra-cs: Heads-up — customer requested an explicit rollback plan if SLA breaches during POC. Jason, include canary fallback to hosted smaller model and a contact list.
jason-pm: Noted. I'll add an automated fallback policy and escalation tree.
mia-ramirez: Ok next steps: Andrew — KMS/HSM write-up + perf command included. Jason — capability matrix + runbook + attachments. Liam — pricing bands & anonymized ranges. Terra — legal/NDA + dataset ask. I'll assemble final RFI reply after 5pm PT and submit to Northstar.
liam-m: I pushed a draft capability_matrix.csv to GDrive: https://drive.redwood.com/sales/northstar/capability_matrix_v1.csv (commented)
andre-eng: Small nit: link broken in Slack paste (typo).
liam-m: Fixed: https://drive.redwood.com/sales/northstar/capability_matrix_v1.csv
terra-cs: Filing note — requested timeline from customer: start POC week of Apr 8, two weeks. They asked for a dry-run east-west networking check prior to start.
mia-ramirez: Thanks team. If no blockers by 4:30pm PT I will send. :thumbsup:
